description: Red Team Village focuses on offensive security operations, adversary emulation, AI in hacking, red team infrastructure (CyberWraith), and community CTF competitions.

talks.title: The Future of AI, Machine Learning, and Offensive Security
talks.teaser: Bruce Schneier, Omar Santos, and industry AI leaders debate the future of artificial intelligence in offensive security, automated exploitation, and red teaming.

talks.title: Message About the Red Team Village CTF
talks.teaser: Silicon Valley character Russ Hanneman delivers a humorous hype message for the DEF CON 29 Red Team Village CTF competition.

talks.title: Custom Mechanical Keyboard Build
talks.teaser: A hands-on maker session demonstrating custom mechanical keyboard assembly, PCB soldering, key switch lubing, and firmware flashing.

talks.title: Red Team Village CTF Day 3
talks.teaser: Daily scoreboard update, challenge walkthrough highlights, and competition standings for Day 3 of the Red Team Village CTF.

talks.title: CTF Recap and Upcoming Events
talks.teaser: The Red Team Village team recaps competition highlights, announces CTF winners, and previews upcoming community training events.

talks.title: Red Team Village CTF Day 2
talks.teaser: Daily leaderboard update and ongoing challenge progress for Day 2 of the Red Team Village CTF competition.

talks.title: Red Team Village CTF Day 1
talks.teaser: Kickoff briefing, rules of engagement, and Day 1 scoreboard update for the DEF CON 29 Red Team Village CTF.

talks.title: AI and Offensive Security: Bruce Schneier Keynote
talks.teaser: Security technologist Bruce Schneier shares perspectives on AI-driven hacking, automated vulnerability discovery, and the societal implications of machine-speed attacks.

talks.title: CyberWraith: Red Team Village C2 & Infrastructure Framework
talks.teaser: An introduction and technical overview of CyberWraith, the Red Team Village's open-source command-and-control and engagement infrastructure platform.
